totalTokens.label: tokens

totalCacheReadShare.label: of the corpus's tokens were cache reads

totalGatesSkipped.label: gates skipped

totalGatesOptional.label: gates marked optional

totalGatesCrashed.label: of the red gates never ran at all

runsWithARedGate.label: runs that ever saw a red gate

sessionsThatDidNot.label: sessions ended some other way

othersWithACommit.label: of the sessions that did not roll over recorded a commit

totalSoftBreaks.label: soft breaks

cappedWindows.label: windows that ran under a measured ceiling

sessionsUnderACeiling.label: sessions run under a ceiling

nudgesDelivered.label: sessions were nudged to wrap up
